text: The paper reports that RL on comparisons was about as effective as behavioural cloning on demonstrations after 5k-10k demonstrations, but comparisons were far more efficient on the margin after 10k-20k demonstrations. Comparisons were also 3x as fast to collect as demonstrations.
title: RL on comparisons more label-efficient than BC once past 10k-20k demonstrations
